_comment: Input for apify/website-content-crawler used by run_guideline_surv.py. This is a reference you can paste into the Apify console to test ONE source. The collector builds this per-source from source_registry.yaml (crawlerType 'cheerio' for type:html, else 'playwright:firefox'). maxCrawlPages=1/maxCrawlDepth=0 = fetch just the target page. Read the returned item's 'text'/'markdown' field.
